description: No complete machine-checkable equivalence map covers SQL dialects, nulls, collations, timestamps and errors.
resolution_condition: Publish editioned dialect-to-canonical semantic mappings with counterexamples.

description: Most production rewrite rule sets are tested but not formally proved over their complete semantic domain.
resolution_condition: Attach formal proof, bounded proof scope or explicit unproven status to every rewrite.

description: Correlation, skew, stale statistics and UDFs make point cardinality estimates dangerously overconfident.
resolution_condition: Represent distributions/intervals, calibration evidence and replan thresholds.

description: CPU-centric scalar costs do not compare memory, network, storage, GPU transfer, energy and monetary cost reliably.
resolution_condition: Define calibrated multi-resource cost vectors and dominance/selection laws.

description: Static feature matrices do not prove deployed behavior, limits or semantic fidelity.
resolution_condition: Require deployment probes, conformance receipts and expiry triggers.

description: UDF signatures commonly omit effects, volatility, failure, parallel safety, cancellation and resource bounds.
resolution_condition: Make the full extension contract mandatory and refuse incomplete functions.

description: Parallel reductions, FMA, libm, precision and compiler flags prevent automatic cross-target bitwise identity.
resolution_condition: Bind an explicit reproducibility posture and target-qualified numerical oracle.

description: Adaptive plan changes can alter ordering, failure timing or numerical reduction order even when relational rows match.
resolution_condition: Prove the full observable contract for every adaptive transition.

description: No common capability vocabulary compares codecs by logical types, random access, vectorization, energy and corruption behavior.
resolution_condition: Qualify codec offers against the kernel schema and benchmark envelopes.

description: Approximate results often omit algorithm edition, parameters, seed, merge history and achieved error diagnostics.
resolution_condition: Standardize approximation provenance in result receipts.

description: GQL, SQL/PGQ, openCypher, SPARQL and GraphBLAS cover different data and result semantics.
resolution_condition: Define explicit ACL mappings with information-loss and unsupported-feature gaps.

description: CRS edition, axis order, antimeridian, validity and robust-predicate behavior vary across providers.
resolution_condition: Bind CRS/geometry precision contracts and exact-refinement oracles.

description: Remote dialect and snapshot differences can make pushdown observably inequivalent.
resolution_condition: Prove operator-by-operator remote equivalence for the concrete connector and deployment.

description: Component-local retry or checkpoint claims do not establish end-to-end exactly-once effects.
resolution_condition: Compose source, exchange, state and sink delivery contracts with deduplication evidence.

description: Cancellation granularity, cleanup, remote propagation and partial effects are inconsistently exposed.
resolution_condition: Require cancellation-safe points and partial-effect receipts for every runtime offer.

description: There is no universal plan/runtime receipt for memory, I/O, network, device, energy and money consumption.
resolution_condition: Define versioned estimate and observed-resource receipt schemas.

description: Arrow C Device ABI remains experimental and target synchronization conventions are not uniformly implemented.
resolution_condition: Qualify exact implementation versions and retain copy-based fallback when legal.

description: Equivalent operator support does not imply identical null, error, overflow, order or numeric behavior.
resolution_condition: Create per-kernel semantic, adversarial and cross-target conformance suites.
